_comment: Prestige specializations: three role families, each with a Mercy and a Dominion variant. Eligibility = family requirements + variant alignment threshold. Features are read by the rules layer (see Prestige class). Extensible: add a family or variant here; the feature keys are generic.

warden.name: Warden
warden.desc: Martial specialists who make themselves the fixed point of a fight.

weaver.name: Weaver
weaver.desc: Resonance specialists who reshape the field itself.

shade.name: Shade
shade.desc: Infiltrators who decide when, and whether, a fight begins.

bulwark_sentinel.name: Bulwark Sentinel
bulwark_sentinel.desc: Mercy Warden. Guardian Aura: every ally within 5 m gains +2 Defense, refreshed each round. +1 Will.

iron_marshal.name: Iron Marshal
iron_marshal.desc: Dominion Warden. Terror Strike: confirmed melee criticals leave organic targets Feared for 2 rounds. +1 melee attack.

lumen_weaver.name: Lumen Weaver
lumen_weaver.desc: Mercy Weaver. Mercy powers cost 2 less, and healing powers restore 50% more.

void_cantor.name: Void Cantor
void_cantor.desc: Dominion Weaver. +2 save DC on Dominion powers; Arc Lance and Arc Storm chain to one extra target.

ghost_envoy.name: Ghost Envoy
ghost_envoy.desc: Mercy Shade. Enemies notice you half as fast; +4 Persuasion.

night_broker.name: Night Broker
night_broker.desc: Dominion Shade. Sneak attacks deal +2d6 more; +2 Stealth.
